messages:
Lina (CS): quick heads-up — ACME trial looks at-risk. Onboarding still at 18% completion and weekly activity dropped to near zero. thinking a 7-day rescue script + downgrade-soften path. anyone see blockers?
Ajay (Success): can you drop the account id and last touch? I can check outreach history.
Lina (CS): account: ACME-4701. last rep touch 2026-02-18. key signals: no model calls in 10 days, only 2 sessions with our sample prompts. query I ran:
```sql
SELECT user_id, event, ts FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id='ACME-4701' AND ts >= current_date - interval '14 days';
```
results: mostly 'project:create' but no `generate` events.
Ben (Enablement): this screams gating on templates + initial prompt engineering. propose 30-min live session, tailored 1-2 prompts to quick-win. I can run the session Wed or Thu.
Sara (SE): agree. also consider temporary quota bump so they can experiment without throttling. can we do +20% for 7 days? Ops?
Maria (PDM): if we surface a clear ROI quick-win (e.g., 1 saved hour per rep), renewal risk drops. can we craft a one-pager with before/after flows? I can template that.
Lina (CS): Metrics bot posted churn risk: 0.64 (HIGH). @Ajay can you do a personalized outreach and propose the session? I'll prep the custom prompts and the one-pager.
Ajay (Success): on it — emailing now with 2 time slots and the subject: "Quick enablement to unblock your first 2 use-cases". will cc Lina.
metrics-bot: churn_score(ACME-4701)=0.64; last_active_days=10; onboarding_pct=18.
Ben (Enablement): session draft agenda: 1) 10m review of goals, 2) 10m prompt tuning, 3) 10m deployment checklist + quick wins doc. Shareable link to doc after session.
Lina (CS): Action checklist (7-day rescue):
- Day 0: Ajay outreach + schedule session.
- Day 1: Live 30m enablement (Ben).
- Day 2: Send tailored one-pager ROI (Maria).
- Day 3: Apply temp +20% quota (ops).
- Day 5: Follow-up: sample prompts + invitation to pilot embed into app.
- Day 7: escalate to AM if no engagement (Sara).
Also capture feedback in short form after session: 3 q's (value?, blockers?, next step).
Maria (PDM): I'll produce the one-pager template and the short feedback form. putting draft link in #cs-templates after lunch.
Sara (SE): I'll liaise with ops for the quota bump — tagging ops in thread.
Lina (CS): thanks team — labeling this "rescue:ACME-4701" in our tracker. will update thread after session. :thumbsup:
